caseNameFull: Jacqueline Shiplet v. Thomas J. Vilsack, Secretary of Agriculture

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file a petition for writ of certiorari with the *652supplemental appendix under seal denied without prejudice to filing a renewed motion together with either a redacted supplemental appendix, or an explanation as to why the supplemental appendix may not be redacted, within 30 days.
